opening.argument: The clearest features here are the staged romantic performance and its conventional production framing: the description calls it a “heartwarming and melodious romantic song,” while the video presents love, relationships, singing, dancing, and affectionate scenes involving performers. Production credits and closing logos further identify a produced music work rather than a deceptive offer. The requests to watch, like, share, and subscribe are ordinary audience engagement tied to “more beautiful melodies, heartwarming stories, and captivating performances.” Nothing in those requests connects participation to payment, investment, private data, or a promised financial outcome, so they do not establish deceptive conduct.
